newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIUPANK 1996 GROUP PROFIT 75 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: HOIUPANK 1996 GROUP PROFIT 75 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonian Hoiupank said on Friday that its group 1996 profit was 75 million kroons, 48.1 million kroons higher than in 1995.
The group's profit from other financial activities, including income from securities, rose from 13.6 million kroons in 1995 to 70.5 million kroons.
Group net profit from services rose to 71.7 million kroons, a growth of 32.5 million kroons.
The bank said loans to clients at the end of 1996 were 2.23 billion kroons versus 936.21 million kroons.
Assets rose to 4.34 billion kroons from 2.60 billion kroons and deposits were 3.14 billion kroons versus 2.11 billion kroons.
